1.w: And these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn Amnon by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel by Abigail the Carmelitess;

2.w: the third Absalom son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah son of Haggith;

3.w: the fifth Shephatiah by Abital; the sixth Ithream by Eglah his wife.

4.w: Six were born to him in Hebron, and he reigned there seven years and six months. And thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.

5.w: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon—four by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel;

6.w: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Eliphelet,

7.w: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

8.w: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet—nine.

9.w: All [were] the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

10.w: And the son of Solomon [was] Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

11.w: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

12.w: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

13.w: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

14.w: Amon his son, [and] Josiah his son.

15.w: And the sons of Josiah: The firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

16.w: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, [and] Zedekiah his son.

17.w: And the sons of Jeconiah the captive: Shealtiel his son,

18.w: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

19.w: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister,

20.w: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, [and] Jushab-hesed—five.

21.w: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jeshaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, [and] the sons of Shechaniah.

22.w: And the sons of Shechaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat—six.

23.w: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam—three.

24.w: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani—seven.
